rules.expected_retrieval_k0: TRUE only when the frozen corpus contains no grade >= 2 evidence-bearing candidate that Search should usefully surface.
rules.expected_no_sufficient_evidence: TRUE when the frozen corpus cannot fully support the Requirement.
rules.partial_case: A case with grade >= 2 evidence but incomplete Requirement support has expected_retrieval_k0=FALSE and expected_no_sufficient_evidence=TRUE.
rules.corpus_gap_or_true_negative: A case with no grade >= 2 evidence has expected_retrieval_k0=TRUE; no-sufficient-evidence is reported independently.

projections.projection_rule: expected_retrieval_k0=true iff frozen corpus has no Gold evidence item with grade >= 2; expected_no_sufficient_evidence is independent and reflects full Requirement sufficiency.
